title: Farm protest tore apart Akali Dal-BJP alliance; six years later joined hands

ai.summary: The Shiromani Akali Dal and BJP revived their political alliance ahead of Punjab's 2027 Assembly elections after a six-year split over farm laws, with both parties emphasizing their commitment to Punjab's development and farmer welfare.

facts.claim: The Shiromani Akali Dal and BJP revived their political alliance ahead of Punjab's 2027 Assembly elections after a six-year split over farm laws
facts.quote: From a 24-year-old political partnership to a bitter divorce over controversial national farm laws, the one-man ruled regional Shiromani Akali Dal and the BJP on Tuesday joined hands ahead of the polls to the 117-seat Assembly

facts.claim: both parties emphasizing their commitment to Punjab's development and farmer welfare
facts.quote: I would like to emphasise one thing: Eliminating drugs from Punjab will be our primary objective, and strengthening nationalist forces in Punjab will also be one of our key priorities

ai.background_note: The Akali Dal and BJP previously split in June 2020 over farm laws, leading to the Akali Dal's exit from the NDA and a 2022 election where they won only three seats in Punjab's 117-member Assembly.
